name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi
tuitionNote: Foreign-national institute fee circular (home.iitd.ac.in, 2025-26 UG entry) lists tuition as USD 2,000/yr plus INR 22,400/yr other charges; converted at ~0.92 EUR/USD. Master's figure assumed equal to Bachelor's tuition (separate MTech foreign-national schedule not confirmed) -- verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade (or equivalent) with strong PCM background; foreign nationals admitted via DASA/direct institute channel with JEE-equivalent or SAT/qualifying exam scores; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; GATE or equivalent qualifying exam/institute assessment for foreign nationals; English proficiency required

name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay
tuitionNote: Foreign-national fee schedule (acad.iitb.ac.in fee circulars, 2025) cites ~INR 3,00,000/semester for foreign nationals without PIO/OCI (~INR 6,00,000/yr); converted at 1 INR = 0.0108 EUR. PIO/OCI holders pay domestic rates instead -- figures vary by source and category, verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with strong PCM background; foreign nationals admitted through direct institute admission/JEE-equivalent process; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; GATE or equivalent; English proficiency required

name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras
tuitionNote: Source figure found is for MTech foreign-national fees (~INR 1,80,000/yr per fees.iitm.ac.in circular references); converted at 0.0108 EUR/INR. Used as proxy for Bachelor's tuition since a separate BTech foreign-national figure was not confirmed in search -- verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with strong PCM background; foreign nationals admitted via DASA or institute direct-entry route; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; GATE or equivalent qualifying exam; English proficiency required

name: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad
tuitionNote: IIMA does not offer a Bachelor's program; figure shown is the flagship PGP (MBA-equivalent) overseas/international candidate fee, reported as USD 50,000 total for the 2-year program (~USD 25,000/yr), converted at ~0.92 EUR/USD (iima.ac.in / multiple admissions blogs, 2025). Sources show wide variation (some cite total program cost up to USD 50k inclusive of all charges) -- verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: Not applicable -- IIM Ahmedabad does not offer undergraduate/Bachelor's degrees
masterRequirements: Bachelor's degree (any discipline) with strong academic record; GMAT/CAT or equivalent for international applicants; English proficiency required; significant work experience preferred for PGPX

name: Indian Institute of Science Bangalore
tuitionNote: IISc publishes a general AY2025-26 fee structure (iisc.ac.in) but a separate, clearly broken-out foreign-national/international fee figure could not be confirmed via search. Estimated at ~INR 2,00,000/yr in line with comparable IITs, converted at 0.0108 EUR/INR -- this figure is NOT confirmed from an official foreign-national fee table and must be verified directly with IISc's Office of International Relations before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: Admission to the Bachelor of Science (Research) program via KVPY/JEE/NEET or equivalent; foreign nationals admitted through Office of International Relations channel; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; GATE or equivalent qualifying exam; English proficiency required

name: University of Delhi
tuitionNote: Foreign-student course fee for B.Sc (Hons) Computer Science cited at INR 1,94,000/yr plus a one-time INR 40,000 registration fee and INR 18,000/yr course registration charge (fsr.du.ac.in / du.ac.in international admissions page, figures vary by program). Note: SAARC-country and Tibetan-national students pay domestic Indian-student fees instead, which are far lower -- figures conflict across sources by program/college; verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade (CBSE/equivalent) meeting cut-off/merit criteria for chosen college and course; foreign nationals apply through DU's international student admission portal; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree meeting departmental eligibility; entrance test or merit-based admission depending on program; English proficiency required

name: Jawaharlal Nehru University
tuitionNote: JNU cut international fees up to 80% from 2025-26 (British Council, jnu.ac.in ISA fee structure). SAARC-region science students now pay USD 300/semester (~USD 600/yr), humanities USD 200/semester (~USD 400/yr); non-SAARC/other countries pay USD 1,000-1,250/semester. Figure shown uses the SAARC science rate (most relevant for Bangladeshi applicants), converted at ~0.92 EUR/USD -- rates differ substantially by region and discipline, verify exact current schedule before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade/equivalent; foreign nationals (including SAARC) admitted via JNU's International Students Admission process; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; JNU entrance assessment or equivalent for international students; English proficiency required

name: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani
localName: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani
tuitionNote: ISA (International Students Admission) fee schedule for AY2024-25 (bitsadmission.com) lists SAARC-country students at ~INR 3,67,500/semester (~INR 7,35,000/yr) and non-SAARC international students at ~INR 6,23,500/semester (~INR 12,47,000/yr); converted at 0.0108 EUR/INR. Figure shown uses the SAARC rate (relevant for Bangladeshi applicants); fees are revised annually so 2025-26 figures may differ -- verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with strong PCM background; international/NRI applicants admitted via SAT or BITSAT-equivalent under the ISA scheme; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; institute-specific entrance criteria for international applicants; English proficiency required

name: Jadavpur University
tuitionNote: Foreign-national (self-sponsored) fee structure for Science/Engineering UG & PG, effective March 2025 (jadavpuruniversity.in fee circular): USD 4,800/yr tuition + USD 1,500/yr annual session fee (~USD 6,300/yr total), converted at ~0.92 EUR/USD. Students from developing/low-income countries may be eligible for a 50% fee concession on some components -- confirm whether Bangladeshi nationals qualify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with relevant subject background; foreign nationals apply through the university's Foreign Students cell; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; departmental entrance/merit criteria for foreign nationals; English proficiency required

name: Anna University
tuitionNote: Sources conflict: one source cites USD 5,000/yr for B.Tech international students, another cites 'from USD 7,500/yr' for foreign nationals generally (unipage.net, testprepkart.com). Figure shown uses the lower USD 5,000/yr estimate converted at ~0.92 EUR/USD -- treat as approximate and verify the exact current foreign-national/supernumerary-seat fee with Anna University admissions before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with PCM background; foreign nationals/NRI admitted via supernumerary quota seats; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree (engineering); GATE or equivalent/university entrance criteria for foreign nationals; English proficiency required

name: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi
localName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi
tuitionNote: AIIMS Delhi charges foreign-national MBBS candidates a total of USD 75,000 over the 5-year (approx.) program, paid in 3 installments (iquanta.in / ensureeducation.com, 2025 admissions cycle); averaged to ~USD 15,000/yr and converted at ~0.92 EUR/USD. Only 7 of 132 annual MBBS seats are reserved for foreign nationals, making this a highly limited/competitive pathway -- per-year breakdown is an approximation since fees are charged per phase, not per year; verify before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with Physics, Chemistry, Biology; NEET or equivalent qualifying exam; foreign nationals admitted through the limited foreign-national MBBS quota; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: MBBS or equivalent medical degree; NEET-PG or equivalent qualifying exam; English proficiency required

name: Manipal Academy of Higher Education
tuitionNote: Figures are estimates for MAHE's Foreign/NRI category B.Tech engineering programs (manipal.edu fee pages cite domestic B.Tech at ~INR 24.3 lakh for 4 years; foreign/NRI rates are higher but not clearly published), approximated at ~INR 6,00,000/yr (Bachelor's) and ~INR 5,00,000/yr (Master's), converted at 0.0108 EUR/INR. Note: MAHE's MBBS program (KMC Manipal) for NRI/international students is a much higher outlier, reported at ~USD 49,450/yr -- engineering/general programs were used here as more broadly representative; verify exact current Foreign/NRI fee schedule before publishing.
bachelorRequirements: 12th grade with relevant subject background (PCM for engineering, PCB for medical programs); foreign/NRI applicants admitted via MAHE's international admissions office; English proficiency required
masterRequirements: Relevant Bachelor's degree; program-specific entrance criteria for foreign/NRI applicants; English proficiency required
